answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. An agent burns twice its 30-day earnings for one of 200 work slots, checked at a vertex of independent peers. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, while idle fakes pile up like sand into a dune and earn nothing, as unworked slots expire after 3 epochs. An honest agent pays once, like a willow that keeps yielding, and recovers the deposit in 6 epochs, so rewards stay undiluted.
